.gn-nav: margin-inline: calc(50% - 50vw); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; background: var(--gn-surface); box-shadow: var(--gn-shadow-lift);
.gn-nav__inner: display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.25rem; max-width: 80rem; margin-inline: auto;
.gn-nav__links: display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0;
.gn-nav__brand: flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; margin-inline-end: 0.5rem;
.gn-nav__brand-tile: flex: 0 0 auto; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--gn-brand); color: var(--gn-text-inverted); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
.gn-nav__corner: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex: none;
.gn-nav__avatar-button: border-radius: 999px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer;
.gn-nav__inbox-dot: position: absolute; top: 0.55rem; right: 0.55rem; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--gn-success); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.125rem var(--gn-surface);
.gn-nav__menu: position: absolute; inset-inline-end: 0; top: calc(100% + 0.5rem); min-width: 14rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 0.375rem; background: var(--gn-surface-raised); border-radius: var(--gn-radius-card); box-shadow: var(--gn-shadow-lift-near); z-index: 50;
.gn-nav__menu-header: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem 0.625rem;
.gn-nav__menu .gn-nav__menu-item: justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--gn-radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--gn-text); font: inherit; text-align: start; cursor: pointer;
.gn-nav__menu .gn-nav__menu-item--signou: margin-top: 0.375rem; padding-top: 0.375rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--gn-fill-secondary); border-radius: 0 0 var(--gn-radius-control) var(--gn-radius-control);
.gn-nav a, .gn-nav button: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-height: 2.75rem; min-width: 2.75rem;
.gn-nav a, .gn-nav__more-toggle: border-radius: 0.75rem; padding-inline: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.1px; color: var(--gn-text-muted); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color var(--gn-motion-feedback) ease-out, color var(--gn-motion-feedback) ease-out; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer;
.gn-nav a[aria-current='page'], .gn-nav: background: var(--gn-surface-raised); box-shadow: var(--gn-shadow-lift); color: var(--gn-text); font-weight: 600; border-radius: 0.75rem;
